# iOS Privacy Manifest Checker

> Free, browser-local checker: scans your Swift/Objective-C source for Apple's Required Reason API usage and compares it against your PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy manifest, so a missing declaration doesn't cost you an App Store rejection (ITMS-91061 / ITMS-91055). Nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [This checker vs. guessing from Apple's docs or waiting for App Review to reject the build](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/ios-privacy-manifest-check/vs-waiting-for-app-review.html)
